{{Quote|Command station, this is ''ST 321''…|An Imperial officer|<ref name="rotj" />}}
'''''ST 321''''' was a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] which served as the personal [[transport]] of [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]], a [[Dark Lord of the Sith]], during the [[3 ABY|latter]] [[4 BBY|stages]] of the [[Galactic Civil War]]. In 4 ABY, ''ST 321'' ferried the [[Sith]] [[Sith Lord|Lord]] to the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station]], which was undergoing its final stage of construction above the [[moon]] [[Endor]]. ''ST 321'' managed to survive the destruction of the [[battle station]] at the [[Battle of Endor]], as [[Luke Skywalker]] piloted the [[shuttle]] out of the second [[Death Star]] moments before it exploded. 

==History==
{{Quote|Inform the commander that Lord Vader's shuttle has arrived.|[[Lieutenant]] [[Endicott]]|<ref name="rotj" />}}
[[File:LordVadersShuttleHasArrived-RotJAVA.png|thumb|300px|left|ST 321 arrives at second Death Star]]
''ST 321'' served as the personal [[transport]] of [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]], the right hand and secret [[Sith apprentice]] of [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]], sole ruler of the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="beware">''[[Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!]]''</ref> In [[4 ABY]],<ref name="GA">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> ''ST 321'' brought Vader to the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]], an Imperial [[planet]]-killing [[battle station]] being constructed in [[orbit]] of the [[Endor|Sanctuary Moon]] of [[Endor (planet)|Endor]].<ref name="beware" />

Although ''ST 321'' had a [[captain]] assigned to it, Vader occasionally piloted it himself. He notably did so shortly after the Emperor's arrival at the Death Star, piloting the shuttle down from the battle station to the Imperial base that guarded [[Death Star's shield generator|its shield generator]] on the Sanctuary Moon. Shortly thereafter, even as a massive [[Battle of Endor|battle]] between the Empire and the enemy [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] took place in orbit, Vader dueled his estranged son, the Alliance hero [[Luke Skywalker]], aboard the Death Star. Ultimately, Vader chose to redeem himself and turned on the Emperor to protect his son, but he was mortally wounded in the process. With the Death Star about to explode, Skywalker used ''ST 321'' to escape the endangered battle station along with his deceased father.<ref name="beware" />

[[File:ST321Away-ROTJ.png|thumb|300px|right|Luke Skywalker pilots ST 321 away from the doomed second Death Star.]]
Upon slipping out of the rapidly deteriorating Death Star, Vader's shuttle was almost intercepted by [[Shara Bey]] of the Alliance's [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Green Squadron]], who proceeded to cover it from incoming [[TIE/IN interceptor]]s after identifying its pilot, Luke Skywalker, as a friendly.<ref name="SE1">[[Shattered Empire 1|''Shattered Empire'' 1]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
''ST 321'' later reappeared in the [[1997]] [[List of changes in Star Wars re-releases|re-release]] of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] when Darth Vader returned to the ''[[Executor]]'' during the film's climax, largely due to their reusing the scene of Darth Vader's arrival on the Death Star II from [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}} {{C|[[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|Special Edition]]}}</ref>
